title: Knowledge Transfer docs vs Devin Wiki
summary: 75 code-verified questions on ky, flask and hono. Docs-only reading 62.7% vs Devin 52.3%; repository Q&A 81.3% vs 71.3% with 2.7% false claims vs 22.7%; 460 files cited vs 315, 0 uncovered questions vs 2.

title: Automations vs Devin
summary: Twelve automations, four rounds, one real repository. NeoDevEx went from 2/7 to 10/10 passing after 54 fixes the study and two code audits found: GitHub, CI and PR triggers; schedules within 2 s; repo-scoped triggers; verified delivery; run recovery; spend and rate limits; failure alerts; webhooks set up in the app; background running. Devin passes 7/10 and goes deeper on the default model; with Gemini 2.5 Pro our reviews match it on correctness and show executed proof.

title: Token costs vs Devin
summary: 154 real agent runs on Gemini 2.5 Flash, tokens as reported by the provider. The Layman integration as shipped saved 0 tokens on a fresh install; moved to where tokens go (skills index, automation contract), the same tasks use 36% fewer tokens and cost 35% less with the same pass rate (17/20 vs 16/20). Same triage task: Devin $0.22, NeoDevEx $0.017.
